## HotBot change checklist

- [ ] I read `BOT_DEVELOPMENT_RULES.md` and `AGENTS.md` before editing.
- [ ] I based changes on current `main` and checked affected files/callers.
- [ ] I preserved existing public commands, names, features and storage formats.
- [ ] I increased `__version__` in **every modified versioned Python file**.
- [ ] Every changed complete Python file starts with `# exact/repo/path.py`.
- [ ] I checked syntax and ran available offline tests.
- [ ] I checked permission failures, restart recovery and duplicate-state effects.
- [ ] I documented anything not covered by live Discord/Railway integration tests.
- [ ] I supplied full replacement files and the repository-path ZIP when requested.

### Old → new Python versions

| File | Old | New |
|---|---|---|
| | | |

### Test results and limitations

Describe the commands actually run and their results. Do not claim live Discord
or Railway verification without actually running it.
